title: GTA 6 Rakes in Over $750 Million in Preorders 2 Weeks Ahead of Release
description: Data compiled by Sensor Tower reveals that GTA 6 has already generated over $750 million in preorders across PlayStation 5 and Xbox platforms.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Crushes Records with Over $750 Million in Preorders

The hype surrounding Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster continues to shatter expectations. According to data compiled by analytics firm Sensor Tower, GTA 6 has already raked in more than $750 million in preorders across both the PlayStation 5 and Xbox platforms, with just two weeks remaining before its official launch.

As one of the most anticipated entertainment events in history, the title has consistently dominated gaming headlines since its initial reveals. Now, with the release date rapidly approaching, the immense consumer anticipation has translated into staggering financial milestones. Securing over $750 million in preorders across current-generation consoles cements the game's position as a monumental force in the global entertainment industry.

## A Massive Milestone for Console Platforms

Sensor Tower's analytics specifically highlight the performance across PlayStation 5 and Xbox hardware. While a detailed breakdown between the specific console ecosystems was not part of the initial data release, the combined figures demonstrate the overwhelming demand among console players to secure their copies ahead of launch day.

Reaching the three-quarters-of-a-billion-dollar mark in preorders two weeks prior to release is a rare feat in modern gaming. It highlights not only the enduring legacy of the franchise, but also the sheer scale of the player base eagerly waiting to step back into the world of Grand Theft Auto.

## Editor's Take

Generating over $750 million in preorders two weeks before launch is a phenomenal achievement that proves GTA 6 is in a league of its own. This staggering figure underlines the unprecedented level of demand from players on PlayStation 5 and Xbox. It is a clear indicator that Rockstar Games is poised to launch one of the most successful media products of all time.
